blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Jacob Cortez shouldered the blame for La Salle’s loss to the University of Santo Tomas in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Mall of Asia Arena on Wednesday. The Green Archers lost 80-75 after the Growling Tigers outsteadied them down the stretch despite having one of the league’s best clutch performers in Cortez. “It’s all on me,” he said. “I think everyone knows that in close game situations, I have a role. My teammates and coaches trust me on that, but today I just failed them.” READ: UAAP: UST bounces back, squeaks past La Salle “I know I […]...
